summary: Guarded 00535320 material invocation on the existing GameNativeGuiEffectApplication private cache, with canonical material-owner registration and an authenticated ready-only 00D5E520 renderer profile view.

source.scope: Source receipt captured while normal Win32 build runs; verify unchanged pins/patch after terminal build result. No runtime admission.

admission: Existing effect application is ready and in its established renderer/VFS/Lua domain.
Geometry object, registry context and static registry callbacks are the exact renderer-owned instances.
Actual owner registry and raw VFS string provider match the established graph.
Material and parameter pools are the canonical, distinct, already-started GameNativeMaterialProcess pools 00F8D3AC and 00F8D3E4.
The profile is borrowed from the ready renderer authenticated read-only map at 00D5E520; selectors are 00BD30E0 and 00B194B0.
effect_order: Publish stable operation frame and caller output pointer.
Invoke the whole existing numeric 00535320 factory against the private cache; preserve its cache acquisition, allocation, constructor, raw-slot-only constructor unwind and temporary effect release.
For non-null material, register metadata using the existing canonical companion without an extra retain, clone or registration rollback.
Verify the canonical actual +04 reference count alias, profile identity and positive creator count.
Complete operation logging, end the name borrow and transfer the existing creator reference to the caller immediately before return.
contract.failure: Retain the operation/factory/cache/registration state and poison the shared effect application after an exception following publication. No retry, caller-name consumption, creator release, cleanup replay or second drain is added.
contract.null_result: A normal null factory result remains null; no companion is manufactured.
contract.name_lifetime: The actual name header and bytes stay stable during synchronous entry. The borrow is marked inactive on return/unwind; the API never consumes the name. Caller cleanup may consume it afterward. Header/frame storage survives any failed graph, but a consumed name is not readable or replayable through the retained pointer.
contract.destruction_access_lifetime: The exact destruction-access object and its borrowed pool/string/owner domains, geometry, mapped profile, renderer, VFS and Lua owner survive material final release and any failed invocation.
contract.shared_drain: Both effect and material operation collections participate in the existing application drain-closure policy. Caller creator ownership is transferred or released through existing actual owner paths before shared drain. Completion checks inspect retained metadata without dereferencing retired materials.

seed_verification.limits: Only these byte ranges were compared. This does not establish whole-image identity.
